outline.chapter_title: Chapter 1: The Efficiency Crisis in Modern LLMs and the Path to 1-Bit Computing
outline.description: This introductory chapter establishes the context for extreme quantization. It reviews the exponential growth of LLM sizes, the associated environmental and economic costs, and the limitations of current post-training quantization techniques. It introduces the concept of '1-bit' computing and motivates the need for a new architectural paradigm.
subtopics: The scaling dilemma: Performance vs. Energy/Memory Costs
Limitations of Post-Training Quantization (PTQ): SmoothQuant, GPTQ, AWQ
The theoretical advantage of Integer Arithmetic over Floating Point
Introduction to BitNet: From Binary to Ternary Representations
Defining the Goal: Matching FP16 Performance with 1.58-bit Precision

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 2: Architectural Foundations of BitNet b1.58
outline.description: This chapter details the core design principles of BitNet b1.58. It explains how standard Transformer layers are modified to support ternary weights {-1, 0, 1}, focusing on the replacement of linear layers and the integration with modern open-source architectures like LLaMA.
subtopics: Replacing nn.Linear with BitLinear: Computational Implications
Adoption of LLaMA-like Components (RMSNorm, SwiGLU, RoPE)
Removal of Bias Terms in Low-Precision Architectures
Integration Strategies with Ecosystem Tools (HuggingFace, vLLM, llama.cpp)

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 3: Quantization Mechanics and Training Methodologies
outline.description: A deep dive into the mathematical mechanisms that allow BitNet b1.58 to train effectively from scratch. This section covers the specific quantization functions used for weights and activations, ensuring stability during training without catastrophic forgetting.
subtopics: The AbsMean Quantization Function for Weights
- Scaling Strategy: Normalizing by Average Absolute Value ($\gamma$)
- RoundClip Operations: Constraining Values to Ternary Set
- Eliminating Zero-Point Shifts for System Optimization
- Training Regimen: Pre-training on RedPajama Dataset
